name: Kraken Reels Charter Services
description: Kraken Reels Charter Services delivers the best deep sea fishing experience out of Orange Beach, Alabama. Led by Captain Jon Ray and his experienced crew, every trip is a fishing adventure tailored to your needs — from family-friendly nearshore runs to adrenaline-filled offshore expeditions. Operating out of Reel Surprise Marina in Orange Beach, Kraken Reels runs a 47-foot Sports Fisherman and a 30-foot Robalo Center Console, both equipped with state-of-the-art electronics, federal permits, and everything you need for a trophy day on the water. Perfect For: Families, bachelor parties, corporate outings, experienced anglers, or first-timers looking for an unforgettable day on the Gulf of Mexico.
